summary: A religious/spiritual app with Katha Section, Community Section, and Admin Panel. Admin can add kathas directly to Katha Section with auto TTS narration. Community photos should appear instantly. App performance needs improvement.
architectural_notes: App has three main sections: Katha Section, Community Section, and Admin Panel
TTS (Text-to-Speech) should be auto-integrated when admin adds a new katha
Community photo uploads should bypass approval delays and show instantly
known_issues: Community photos take ~1 hour to appear after upload due to delay/approval process

existing_features.title: When an admin adds a new Katha from the Admin Panel, it must be saved to the backend and immediately appear in the Kathayen section without requiring any extra approval step or manual publishing action.

Every Katha detail page must include an automatic Text-to-Speech (TTS) narration option. When a Katha is added via the Admin Panel, the TTS narration control must be present on its detail page without any additional configuration required.

Community posts containing images must appear instantly after upload without any approval delay. Remove or bypass any approval queue or pending state for image/media posts so that uploaded photos are visible to the uploader and other users immediately.

Improve overall app performance and smoothness: reduce unnecessary re-renders, optimize React Query cache settings (stale time, cache time), and ensure list pages (Kathayen, Community) load quickly with minimal layout shift.

new_feature_requests.summary: Admin panel se katha add karne par seedha Katha Section mein dikhe bina extra steps ke
Har katha mein automatically TTS (Text-to-Speech) narration option add ho jaye
Community mein upload ki gayi photos turant dikhen bina kisi delay ke
App ki overall performance aur smoothness improve karna
